picture_mode.path: Settings > All Settings > Picture > Picture Mode
steps: Press the Settings button (gear icon) on remote
Select 'All Settings' at bottom of Quick Settings menu
Navigate to 'Picture' tab on left sidebar
Select 'Picture Mode' at top of Picture settings
Choose: Movie, Filmmaker Mode, or Dynamic
picture_mode.recommended: Movie or Filmmaker Mode (for accurate colors)

hdr_tone_mapping.path: Settings > All Settings > Picture > Expert Settings > HDR Tone Mapping

input_signal_plus.path: Settings > All Settings > Connection > External Device Manager > Input Signal Plus
steps: Go to 'Connection' tab on left sidebar
Enable for each HDMI port you use (HDMI 1, 2, 3, 4)
This enables 4K@120Hz, HDR10, HDR10+, and VRR
input_signal_plus.recommended: On for all HDMI ports with 4K sources

game_mode.path: Settings > All Settings > Connection > Game Mode Settings > Game Mode
steps: Or set to 'Auto' to use ALLM detection

vrr.path: Settings > All Settings > Connection > Game Mode Settings > VRR
steps: Supports FreeSync Premium Pro up to 144Hz

allm.path: Settings > All Settings > Connection > Game Mode Settings > Auto Game Mode (ALLM)
steps: TV will auto-switch to Game Mode when console sends ALLM signal

sound_output.path: Settings > All Settings > Sound > Sound Output
steps: Go to 'Sound' tab on left sidebar
Choose: TV Speaker, Soundbar, Receiver, or Bluetooth

sound_mode.path: Settings > All Settings > Sound > Sound Mode
steps: Choose: Standard, Adaptive Sound, Amplify, or Custom

earc.path: Settings > All Settings > Connection > External Device Manager > HDMI eARC Mode
steps: Set to 'Auto' to enable eARC when soundbar/AVR connected

picture_clarity.path: Settings > All Settings > Picture > Expert Settings > Picture Clarity Settings
steps: Adjust Blur Reduction and Judder Reduction
picture_clarity.recommended: Blur Reduction: Off, Judder Reduction: Off (for cinema)

local_dimming.path: Settings > All Settings > Picture > Expert Settings > Local Dimming

recommended_settings.input_signal_plus: On (REQUIRED for 4K HDR/VRR - enable per HDMI port)

samsung_qn70f_75.notes: No Dolby Vision support - Samsung uses HDR10+. Enable Input Signal Plus for full 4K HDR (this is CRITICAL - TV won't display HDR without it). VRR up to 4K@144Hz with FreeSync Premium Pro. For Plex/Emby/Jellyfin: ensure Direct Play is enabled to avoid transcoding.
first_time_setup: 1. Enable Input Signal Plus for each HDMI port (Connection > External Device Manager)
2. Set Picture Mode to Movie or Filmmaker Mode
3. Enable Game Mode settings (VRR, ALLM) if using gaming sources
4. For standalone audio: Set Sound Mode to Adaptive Sound
5. Install Plex/Emby/Jellyfin from Samsung App Store
6. Configure media server app for Direct Play (no transcoding)

steps: Press SETUP button on remote or front panel
Set each speaker position: Front L/R, Center, Surround L/R, etc.
Options: Large, Small, or None for each position
speaker_setup.recommended: Set based on speaker size - Small for bookshelf, Large for floorstanders

steps: Set crossover frequency for each speaker set to 'Small'
crossover.recommended: 80Hz for most bookshelf speakers, 60Hz for larger speakers

steps: Measure distance from each speaker to listening position
Enter distance for each speaker (in feet or meters)
Use a tape measure for accuracy
distance.recommended: Measure accurately - this affects time alignment

steps: Use test tones and SPL meter
Adjust each speaker to same level (75dB reference)
level.recommended: Use SPL meter app, aim for 75dB at listening position

steps: Connect YPAO microphone to front panel YPAO jack
Place microphone at ear height at listening position
Wait for measurement to complete (several minutes)
ypao.recommended: Run YPAO for automatic room correction. See Speaker Tuning guide.

steps: Select decoder mode for stereo content
Options: DTS Neural:X, Dolby Surround, CINEMA DSP, etc.
surround_decode.recommended: DTS Neural:X or Dolby Surround for upmixing stereo to surround

steps: Options: Amp (receiver speakers), TV (TV speakers), or TV+Amp (both)
Connect TV to HDMI OUT (ARC) port on receiver
Enable eARC/ARC on TV as well
earc.recommended: On - enables eARC for lossless audio from TV apps

recommended_settings.speaker_config: Set based on actual speakers (Small with crossover for most)

yamaha_rx_a4a.notes: Good HDMI 2.1 passthrough. Use eARC for best audio from TV apps. YPAO room correction included - run after speaker setup.

plex.preroll_config_path: Settings > Extras > Cinema Trailers Pre-roll Video
plex.preroll_config_notes: Enter the full path to your pre-roll video. Multiple pre-rolls can be separated with semicolons (random) or commas (sequential).

direct_play.reason: Avoids transcoding which can change format

transcoder_quality.reason: If transcoding is needed, use highest quality

sync_playback.path: Settings > Player > Videos > Sync playback to display
